name: jobs-idempotency-conflict
description: Changed content under a settled Idempotency-Key is a 409, not a second run: the service settles by (request, attempt), so a retried submission must keep its key and a changed body under the same key is the conflict, surfaced as a typed error rather than a silent dedupe or a duplicate job.

error.message: the idempotency key already named a different submission
